story_log.title: Blue Jays swept by Orioles, eliminated from playoff contention — Vlad era ends with no postseason for second time in three years
story_log.development: Baltimore swept Toronto in doubleheader (4-2 in both games per ground truth), officially eliminating Blue Jays from playoff contention per TalkinBaseball. Pete Alonso called teammates back onto field to salute Baltimore crowd after final home game per TalkinBaseball. Vlad era: missed playoffs 2026, lost WS 2025, missed 2024, lost ALWC 2023/2022, missed 2021/2020/2019 per StatMuse. Eight years, one pennant, no ring.

story_log.title: AL West race tied at 78-80 — Mariners walk off Astros, both teams neck-and-neck with four games left
story_log.development: Josh Naylor walked off Astros for Seattle per TalkinBaseball — Mariners and Astros now both 78-80, tied atop AL West, Houston holds tiebreaker per TalkinBaseball. Yainer Diaz hit go-ahead triple in 10th, then Naylor ended it per TalkinBaseball. AL West title coming down to final weekend.

story_log.title: Cubs lose to Marlins 2-1 — playoff hopes hanging by thread as Kevin Gausman injured on comebacker
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Miami beat Chicago 2-1 per ground truth. Gausman made incredible play on comebacker but left game, hope he's okay per BarstoolBigCat. 'That was the moment. Fuck' per BarstoolBigCat after Cubs failed to score late. Cubs-Marlins went 11 innings two days ago, now Cubs losing ground in three-way wild card tie.

story_log.title: Lonzo Ball announces retirement at 28 after career-altering knee injury — injuries robbed his potential
story_log.development: Lonzo announced retirement at 28 due to career-altering knee injury per NBAMemes. 'Injuries really robbed Lonzo's potential. He was supposed to be one of greats 😣' per NBAMemes. Three years of rehab couldn't save career that started with so much promise.

story_log.title: Ken Jeong joins Korean-led Team 61 as A's minority owner — 'This is a victory for Major League Baseball. This is a victory for Korea.'
story_log.development: Jeong joined SportsCenter to discuss becoming A's minority owner with Korean-led group Team 61 per SportsCenter. 'To me this is a victory for Major League Baseball. This is a victory for Korea' per SportsCenter. Actor and comedian now part of Oakland ownership.

story_log.title: Ravens and Cowboys head to Rio for Sunday's international game — Lamar Jackson comments on field conditions after criticism
story_log.development: First-ever Rio De Janeiro game Ravens-Cowboys broadcasts on CBS Sunday per CBS Sports. Lamar commented on Rio field ahead of game after conditions drew criticism per CBS Sports. 'Lamar with a bar 🔥 Ravens vs. Cowboys will be played in Rio this Sunday 🇧🇷' per SportsCenter.

story_log.title: Yankees planning for Aaron Judge to miss Wild Card Series — three-time MVP pushing to play, but team expects him out
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Judge told jorgecastillo he intends to play in wild card series next week per JeffPassan/ESPN. But Yankees planning for him to miss it per CBS Sports (from Sept 23) — Judge says he's preparing to play, but body and team may say otherwise per CBS Sports. Judge pushing to return, team being cautious.

story_log.title: Ben Rice hits 40th and 41st home runs of season — Yankees catcher reaches milestone with two-homer game vs Rays
story_log.development: Rice hit 40th HR (leadoff shot) per TalkinBaseball, then added 41st later in game per TalkinBaseball — first time in career reaching 40 HR per TalkinBaseball. Juan Soto also went deep (27th of year) per TalkinBaseball. Yankees rolled Rays per ground truth (9-2).

story_log.title: Dream demolish Liberty 83-65 to secure top-four playoff seed — Allisha Gray 24 points, Atlanta finishes season on five-game win streak
story_log.development: Atlanta destroyed New York 83-65 per ground truth. Allisha Gray: 24 PTS, 4 REB, 5 AST, 3 STL, +21 per StatMuse. Dream finish season on five-game win streak per StatMuse. Sabrina Ionescu assessed Flagrant 1 after inadvertent elbow on Angel Reese, Reese left with face injury per ClutchPoints. Atlanta locks in top-four seed.

story_log.title: Flau'jae Johnson sets Storm rookie scoring record with 626 points despite historic losing season — passes Breanna Stewart
story_log.development: Johnson now has most PTS by Storm rookie all-time with 626, passing Breanna Stewart (621) and Sue Bird (461) per StatMuse. Elite company despite Seattle's worst season in franchise history. Dallas beat Seattle 103-91 per ground truth. CBS Sports profiled how Johnson flourished through adversity.

story_log.title: Jaxson Dart's season officially over — will undergo knee surgery, could return if Giants make playoffs
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Dart to undergo season-ending knee surgery on damaged meniscus, MCL and PCL per ESPN/AdamSchefter — meniscus is main issue per Schefter. John Harbaugh left open possibility Dart could return if Giants land in playoffs per AlbertBreer (timetable usually 4-6 months from meniscus repair, would be early end). Jameis Winston takes over. Giants' Week 1 dream now nightmare.

story_log.title: Giants QB Jaxson Dart likely out for season with knee injury — Jameis Winston takes over, crushing blow after Week 1 optimism
story_log.development: MRI revealed Dart's knee injury significantly worse than initial sprained MCL diagnosis — now facing possibility of season-ending surgery per ESPN/Schefter/Pelissero. Dart grabbed knee in pain after hit by two Rams defenders MNF, carted off, replaced by Winston. Winston goes 1-16 in Week 3. Giants were 1-0 after Dart's 23-29, 230 yds, 3 TD debut vs Cowboys — now season spirals.

story_log.title: Kawhi Leonard signs $115M extension with Raptors, takes discount to help roster — expects to finish career in Toronto
story_log.development: Kawhi agreed to 2yr/$115M extension plus player option for 2028-29 per Shams — took $11M less than max, waived $7.45M trade kicker to give Raptors flexibility. Now locked in through 2029-30. Expects to finish career in Toronto per Shams. Trade from Clippers finalized two weeks ago.

story_log.title: Rays clinch AL East for first time since 2021 — Drew Rasmussen dominant, Yankees' Aaron Judge still sidelined for Wild Card
story_log.development: Tampa Bay clinched AL East after beating Yankees 6-1 per ground truth — first division title since 2021. Rasmussen no-hit Yankees into 7th inning per TalkinBaseball. Yankees announced Judge will NOT be available for Wild Card series next week per ESPN/AdamSchefter. Tampa back on top.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark drops 27-9-7 with 4 steals as Fever beat Lynx for first time since rookie season — Indiana gets revenge
story_log.development: Clark: 27 PTS, 9 AST, 7 REB, 4 STL vs Minnesota per StatMuse/ESPN — first win vs Lynx since rookie season per StatMuse. Indiana blew 29-point lead, Lynx cut to single digits, but Fever held on 96-77 per ground truth. Kelsey Mitchell extended 20-point streak to 27 games. Big win heading into playoffs.

story_log.title: Cubs and Marlins go to 11th inning in playoff-clinching drama — both teams survive bases-loaded jams, Cubs still haven't clinched
story_log.development: Cubs-Marlins went to 11th inning per TalkinBaseball/BarstoolBigCat. Marlins escaped bases-loaded jam in 10th per TalkinBaseball, Cubs survived bases-loaded jam in 11th per TalkinBaseball. BarstoolBigCat: 'End this! We're running out of pitchers and we didn't really have any to begin with!' Cubs trying to clinch playoff spot, game ongoing.

story_log.title: Munetaka Murakami hits 33rd HR to extend White Sox lead over Royals 14-11 — Chicago wins wild shootout
story_log.development: Murakami smacked 33rd HR of season to extend White Sox lead per ClutchPoints — Chicago beat Kansas City 14-11 per ground truth. Wild high-scoring game.

story_log.title: Alex Bregman arrives at ballpark with facial fractures, won't need surgery — hopes to return in Cubs' playoff run
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Bregman arrived at ballpark after suffering multiple facial fractures Sunday per JomboyMedia/CubsCreator — won't undergo surgery, hopeful to return in postseason per recent history (CBS Sports/JeffPassan Sept 22). Video shows him walking into stadium. Tough scene but recovery underway.

story_log.title: Dodgers demolish Padres 7-0 — Tommy Edman deep HR, Will Smith 10th homer, Shohei Ohtani expected back Wednesday
story_log.development: Los Angeles destroyed San Diego 7-0 per ground truth. Tommy Edman crushed deep solo shot per ClutchPoints, Will Smith hit 10th HR of season per TalkinBaseball. CBS Sports: Ohtani expected to come off IL Wednesday as Dodgers ramp up for postseason — has been out since Sept 7 with multiple injuries. Dodgers rolling.

story_log.title: Yordan Alvarez drives in 100th RBI of season to give Astros lead over Mariners — reaches century mark for second straight year
story_log.development: Alvarez knocked in 100th RBI to put Houston ahead vs Seattle per ClutchPoints. Second straight season with 100+ RBI. Astros won 7-0 per ground truth. Yordan continues dominant campaign.

story_log.title: Carlos Cortes crushes go-ahead 2-run HR in 8th to put A's in front over Angels — Oakland wins 9-7
story_log.development: Cortes delivered go-ahead 2-run shot in 8th inning per TalkinBaseball. Athletics beat Angels 9-7 per ground truth. Late-inning heroics.

story_log.title: Zack Wheeler strikes out first 7 batters vs Brewers, sets Phillies franchise record — eventually wins 6-4
story_log.development: Wheeler set Phillies franchise record by striking out first seven batters of game per TalkinBaseball. Finished with 11 SO per StatMuse. Also became 96th player in MLB history to throw 2,000 career strikeouts per TalkinBaseball. Philadelphia beat Milwaukee 6-4 per ground truth. Dominant Wheeler night.

story_log.title: CJ Abrams hits two HRs vs Tigers — first Nat with 30 HR and 100 RBI in season since Juan Soto in 2019
story_log.development: Abrams hit 2 HR, drove in 3 runs vs Detroit per StatMuse — first Nationals player with 30+ HR and 100+ RBI in season since Soto in 2019 per StatMuse. Washington beat Tigers 3-1 per ground truth. Career year.

story_log.title: Portland Fire beat Golden State Valkyries 90-82 in OT — Carla Leite clutch and-1, Gabby Williams attacks to tie, Bridget Carleton rallies from 17-0 deficit
story_log.development: Fire beat Valkyries 90-82 in OT per ground truth. Carleton hit wing three to tie 40-40 after Portland trailed 17-0 per ClutchPoints. Leite delivered clutch and-1 to give Fire 77-75 lead late per ClutchPoints. Williams attacked downhill to tie at 77 and force OT per ClutchPoints. Wild comeback and overtime finish.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson breaks own single-season scoring record with 18 points vs Sparks — now 2nd-most in WNBA history
story_log.development: Wilson: 18 PTS, 10 REB, 2 BLK vs LA per StatMuse — breaks tie with herself for most points in season in franchise history, now 2nd-most in WNBA history per StatMuse. Aces beat Sparks 89-79 per ground truth. Historic scoring season continues.

story_log.title: Giants demolished by Rams 28-6 on MNF — Jaxson Dart sprained MCL, Malik Nabers shoulder injury, season spirals after Week 1 optimism
story_log.development: Giants lost 28-6 per ground truth. Dart feared to have sprained MCL after being crunched by two Rams defenders per CBS Sports/AdamSchefter/ground truth — grabbed knee in pain, carted off, replaced by Jameis Winston. Nabers left with shoulder injury (returned later) per AdamSchefter/BillBarnwell. Andrew Thomas also went down per Ihartitz. Winston disaster: 111 pass yds (fewest ever in 81 career games with 25+ attempts) per Ihartitz, threw red-zone INT per ghetto_gronk. Week 1 Giants beat Cowboys 28-20, looked physical and optimistic — Week 2 everything fell apart.

story_log.title: Davante Adams turns back clock without Puka Nacua — 8-195-2 on MNF, now third all-time in multi-TD receiving games
story_log.development: Adams vs Giants: 8 REC, 195 YDS, 2 TD per StatMuse/ground truth. Puka Nacua inactive (hip) per CBS Sports/AdamSchefter. Adams now has more multi-TD receiving games than everyone except Rice, Moss, T.O. per StatMuse. 33 games with 100+ REC YDS and 1+ TD (most among active players, 7 ahead of Mike Evans) per StatMuse. Stafford: 22-31, 327 YDS, 4 TD — sixth in NFL history in games with 4+ pass TD per StatMuse. Rams earned A grade for steamrolling Giants per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Alex Bregman suffers multiple facial fractures after foul ball strike — hopeful to return in Cubs' playoff run, won't need surgery
story_log.development: Bregman struck by foul ball while in on-deck circle Sunday per JeffPassan/TalkinBaseball. Suffered multiple facial fractures, will not undergo surgery, hopeful to return in postseason per JeffPassan/CBS Sports. Video shows dangerous proximity of on-deck circle per TalkinBaseball. Could force MLB to implement safety measures per TalkinBaseball.

story_log.title: Pete Alonso homers twice vs Mets including 40th of season — gives Orioles lead in 8th, reaches 40 HR milestone in first year with Baltimore
story_log.development: Alonso hit two HRs vs Blue Jays including 40th of season per TalkinBaseball/ground truth — second gave Orioles lead in 8th inning. First 40-HR season with Baltimore. Orioles won 4-3 per ground truth. On pace for 77 targets, 51 receptions, 459 yards, 9 TDs per Ihartitz (sarcastic stat about low volume).

story_log.title: MLB Sunday slate: Tigers crush Nationals 9-2 (Torkelson HR), Giants beat Twins 5-2, Dream beat Liberty 95-84, Mercury edge Wings 87-86
story_log.development: Tigers demolished Nationals 9-2 per ground truth — Spencer Torkelson crushed HR per TalkinBaseball. Giants beat Twins 5-2 per ground truth. Dream beat Liberty 95-84 per ground truth — double-digit scorers: Canada 19, Reese 18, Bonner 17, Howard 16, Gray 14 per StatMuse, Atlanta 8-2 in last 10. Mercury edged Wings 87-86 per ground truth — Kahleah Copper 31 PTS, game-winner with 2.4 left per StatMuse; Alyssa Thomas 15-11-12 (24th career triple-double) per StatMuse; Paige Bueckers 30-5-7 per StatMuse; Jessica Shepard 17-19-6 per StatMuse.

story_log.title: Zach Ertz returns to Eagles — signed to practice squad after Dallas Goedert MCL sprain, expected to be promoted for MNF vs Bears
story_log.development: Eagles signed Ertz to practice squad, expected to be promoted and play Monday night vs Bears per TomPelissero/AdamSchefter. Goedert likely to miss few weeks with sprained MCL per AdamSchefter. Ertz needs 11 more receptions to break Harold Carmichael's franchise record (589 catches) per AdamSchefter. Three-time Pro Bowler played in Philly 2013-21, helped win Super Bowl, spent last two seasons in Washington.

story_log.title: Caleb Williams avoided major hamstring injury — tests came back clean, not ruled out for MNF vs Eagles after leaving Bears-Vikings game in tears
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Tests confirmed Williams avoided major hamstring injury, team not ruling him out for MNF vs Eagles per TomPelissero. Best-case scenario per TomPelissero. Rehab just getting started per TomPelissero. Massive sigh of relief in Chicago per TomPelissero. Story continues from Sunday's emotional cart-off.

story_log.title: Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow again, will consult specialists — Marcus Mariota to start Week 3 vs Seahawks for Commanders
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Daniels underwent imaging, will consult with specialists after dislocating left elbow again per TomPelissero. All signs point to Mariota starting Sunday vs Seahawks per TomPelissero. Story continues from Sunday's injury vs Cowboys.

story_log.title: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, named Vikings starter for Week 3 vs Buccaneers — Carson Wentz led 2-0 start in his absence
story_log.development: Murray cleared concussion protocol, will return as starter Sunday vs Bucs per TomPelissero. Went down with concussion in season opener per recent history, Wentz stepped in and Vikings started 2-0. QB1 back after two-game absence.

story_log.title: Falcons announce Michael Penix Jr. as starting QB for Thursday night vs Packers — will make season debut 10 months after last playing
story_log.development: Penix gets call for Thursday night vs Packers per CBS Sports — first game in 10 months. Falcons have yet to have a drive reach red zone through first two games per AdamSchefter. Penix fully cleared, timing piece of starting Tua Week 1 per recent history.

story_log.title: Darius Slayton signs with Colts after seven seasons with Giants — reunites with Daniel Jones, Alec Pierce dealing with heel injury
story_log.development: Slayton signing with Colts per TomPelissero. Played past seven seasons with Giants, now reunites with Daniel Jones per TomPelissero. Alec Pierce dealing with heel injury per TomPelissero. Indianapolis adds veteran WR depth.

story_log.title: Mookie Betts spending off day in box with Myles Garrett and Aaron Donald's wife Erica during Rams-Giants MNF
story_log.development: Betts in suite with Garrett and Erica Donald (Aaron's wife) during MNF per TalkinBaseball. Dodgers off day, Betts watching football. Cross-sport star sighting.

story_log.title: Josh Allen now has more rushing TDs than three entire divisions — 5 pass TD, 4 rush TD through two games, first in NFL history
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Allen has more rushing TDs than AFC West, NFC East, NFC West combined per StatMuse — also more passing TDs than AFC North per StatMuse. First player in NFL history with 5+ pass TD and 4+ rush TD in first two games per recent history. Story continues from TNF dominance and Sunday stat drops.

story_log.title: Caleb Williams suffers non-contact hamstring injury, carted off in tears — Bears QB status uncertain for Week 3
story_log.development: Williams went down untouched in 4th quarter vs Vikings with apparent hamstring injury per ground truth/SportsCenter/AlbertBreer. Helped off field in significant pain per CBS Sports, carted off in tears giving thumbs up to crowd per SportsCenter/NFLMemes. Ben Johnson: 'He's in good spirits. Won't know severity until Monday' per Pelissero. Bears lost 9-3 per ground truth. Williams emotional after being carted off.

story_log.title: Jayden Daniels dislocates left elbow vs Cowboys, X-rays show no fracture — will miss some time, Commanders rally around Marcus Mariota
story_log.development: Daniels dislocated left elbow on final play of first half vs Cowboys per ground truth/Pelissero/AlbertBreer/SportsCenter. Tried to brace fall, elbow bent backwards per AlbertBreer. X-ray didn't show fracture per Pelissero/Quinn. More tests Monday, will be out for some time per Pelissero. Quinn: 'We'll rally around Marcus (Mariota)' per Pelissero. Washington lost 37-20 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Chiefs survive Colts in OT thriller 33-30 — Mahomes 3 TD, controversial replay, Colts play for tie late
story_log.development: Chiefs beat Colts 33-30 in OT per ground truth. Mahomes: 32-47, 382 pass yds, 3 TD per ClutchPoints. Jonathan Taylor tied it twice: once in regulation, once in OT per SportsCenter/ClutchPoints. Laquon Treadwell controversial play: ruled down by contact, Chiefs didn't recover fumble per ClutchPoints/Mahomes. Colts played for FG in OT instead of going for win per KevinOConnor. Butker game-winner per ClutchPoints. Alec Pierce (heel) left in walking boot per ClutchPoints.

story_log.title: Ja'Marr Chase dominates Texans with absurd TD catch — Bengals roll 20-6, Derek Stingley Jr. helpless
story_log.development: Chase made absurd mid-air adjustment TD catch vs former LSU teammate Stingley per CBS Sports/SportsCenter. Adjusted in mid-air, dragged toes in bounds to break scoreless tie per CBS Sports. Chase clinic vs Houston per SportsCenter. Bengals demolished Texans 20-6 per ground truth. DeMeco Ryans settled for 58-yard FG on 4th & 1 trailing by 7, missed per BackAftaThis.

story_log.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hat trick vs Cardinals — reigning OPOY dominates with 3 TD, Drew Lock deep shots, Seahawks cruise 31-7
story_log.development: JSN: 3 TD vs Cardinals per SportsCenter — reigning OPOY per SportsCenter. Drew Lock hit JSN for two deep TD strikes per SportsCenter/ClutchPoints. JSN now has 3 TD in two games per SportsCenter. BallsackSports: 'Jets saw JSN drop 447 receiving yards in Rose Bowl and said No Thanks' per BallsackSports. Seahawks demolished Cardinals 31-7 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Saints stun Ravens 24-17 — Tyler Shough goal-line QB sneak caps comeback, missed facemask not reviewable
story_log.development: Saints beat Ravens 24-17 per ground truth. Shough may not have been across line BUT took brutal facemask (not reviewable) per AlbertBreer. Review upheld per AlbertBreer. Big comeback week after falling short last week per AlbertBreer. Kellen Moore Era win in Baltimore.

story_log.title: Raiders demolish Chargers 26-14 to start 2-0 — Chargers face brutal schedule at 0-2, Jim Harbaugh offense disaster
story_log.development: Raiders destroyed Chargers 26-14 per ground truth. AlbertBreer: Chargers 0-2, next four at Bills, at Seahawks, vs Broncos, at Chiefs per AlbertBreer. SportsCenter: next 7 games no joke per SportsCenter. Chargers now tied with Raiders at 2-0 in AFC West per AlbertBreer. Getting late early for LA per AlbertBreer.

story_log.title: Dak Prescott surpasses Tony Romo atop Cowboys all-time passing TD list — aims to 'double' the mark
story_log.development: Prescott passed Romo for most passing TD in Cowboys history per CBS Sports. Entered Sunday three behind, now No. 1 per CBS Sports. Prescott aims to 'double' top mark per CBS Sports headline. Dallas beat Washington 37-20 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Patriots demolish Steelers 20-3 — Aaron Rodgers' Steelers offense broken, Monken fires back at Tomlin's 'Browns is the Browns' diss
story_log.development: Patriots destroyed Steelers 20-3 per ground truth. CBS Sports: Steelers offense broken under Rodgers per CBS Sports. Steelers went 3rd & 7 to 4th & 43 per JoeyMulinaro — sums up offense for last 8 years per JoeyMulinaro. Todd Monken fired back at Tomlin's 'Browns is the Browns' diss after win: 'F--- that. Tomlin's words motivated team' per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Packers edge Jets 20-17 in OT — Matt LaFleur under heat after sloppy 1-1 start
story_log.development: Packers beat Jets 20-17 in OT per ground truth. CBS Sports: LaFleur should feel heat amid sloppiness, ugly 1-1 start per CBS Sports. Despite being extended this offseason, deserves scrutiny for eye-popping poor play per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Red Sox clinch playoff berth, Braves clinch NL East — Twins and Tigers eliminated from contention
story_log.development: Red Sox clinched playoff berth (second straight season) per CBS Sports. Braves clinched NL East (7th in last 9 years) per TalkinBaseball — beat Astros 2-0 per ground truth. Twins eliminated per TalkinBaseball. Tigers eliminated per TalkinBaseball. Playoff races tighten with one week left.

story_log.title: NFL Week 2 injury carnage: Kelvin Banks Jr. ankle, Alec Pierce heel, Jadarian Price chest — X-rays negative across board
story_log.development: Banks (Saints LT, 2025 No. 9 pick) suffered ankle injury after sack per CBS Sports. Pierce (Colts WR) left with heel injury, X-rays negative per Pelissero/ClutchPoints — left stadium in walking boot and crutches per ClutchPoints. Price (Seahawks RB) chest injury, X-rays negative per Pelissero. More tests Monday for all three.

story_log.title: Ole Miss defeats LSU 32-24 in Lane Kiffin's hostile return to Oxford — Trinidad Chambliss dominates, Rebels exact revenge
story_log.development: Ole Miss beat LSU 32-24 per ground truth. Chambliss: 325+ pass yds, 2+ pass TD per StatMuse — now 3 such games since Kiffin left vs 2 in 11 games under Kiffin per StatMuse. Chambliss scored go-ahead rush TD, sealed win with INT per ClutchPoints/ESPN. Ole Miss led 24-7 at half per ESPN, LSU rallied to make it close per ESPN. Kiffin's return dominated CFB week — fans lined staircases as he arrived per JomboyMedia, ESPN cut from Holly Rowe to Laura Rutledge per HaterReport, Chambliss cursed on live TV: 'HOTTY F*CKING TODDY' per HaterReport.

story_log.title: Gable Steveson knocked out cold in 12 seconds by Sean Sharaf on UFC 331 debut — Jon Jones watched in horror
story_log.development: Sharaf KO'd Steveson 12 seconds into UFC 331 debut with left hook per LeBatardShow/HaterReport/SportsCenter. Steveson out cold per HaterReport. Jon Jones watched in horror per HaterReport. Olympic gold medalist wrestler's MMA debut disaster.

story_log.title: Arman Tsarukyan brutally knocks out Mauricio Ruffy with elbow, calls for title shot after UFC 331 victory
story_log.development: Tsarukyan KO'd Ruffy with brutal elbow at UFC 331 per LeBatardShow/HaterReport/SportsCenter. Called for title shot after win per SportsCenter/CBS Sports headline. Emphatic lightweight contender statement per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: MLB walkoff bonanza: Ethan Salas, Pavin Smith, Christian Moore all end games in dramatic fashion
story_log.development: Salas (20 years old) hit pinch-hit walkoff for Padres to beat Marlins 7-6 per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints/ground truth. Pavin Smith walkoff HR for Dbacks beat Yankees 5-3 on night celebrating 2001 WS team per TalkinBaseball/ground truth. Christian Moore walkoff hit in 11th for Angels beat Twins 6-5 per ClutchPoints/ground truth. Griffin Conine tied game in 9th off Mason Miller before Salas ended it per TalkinBaseball. Vaughn Grissom tied Angels-Twins in 9th before Moore's winner per ClutchPoints. Wild finishes across MLB.

story_log.title: NC State fumbles intentional safety, Vanderbilt scores TD on return to win 35-31 — all-time ending in college football
story_log.development: NC State led 31-28, attempted intentional safety to run clock, fumbled snap, Vanderbilt returned it for TD to win 35-31 per ground truth/JomboyMedia/PatMcAfeeShow/SharpFootball/CBS Sports. Vandy never led all game until final play per SharpFootball. NC State QB CJ Bailey now under investigation for gambling-related policies, temporarily suspended per BallsackSports. One of craziest endings in CFB history per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Colts WR Keenan Allen facing minimum 3-game suspension for DUI arrest in Indianapolis
story_log.development: Allen facing minimum 3-game suspension stemming from drunk driving arrest in downtown Indianapolis last month per Schefter/ESPN. Will miss at least Colts' first three games. Major blow to Indianapolis offense.

story_log.title: Michael Penix Jr. nearing return, could start Thursday night vs Packers — Falcons' preferred starter back from knee surgery
story_log.development: Penix nearing return, could make 2026 debut Thursday vs Packers per Schefter/RapSheet. Falcons' preferred starter per Schefter. Fully cleared but timing piece of Tua starting Week 1 per AlbertBreer (from Sept 19). Return imminent.

story_log.title: Trinidad Chambliss surges to Heisman favorite after leading Ole Miss past LSU with clutch TD drive
story_log.development: Chambliss now Heisman frontrunner after leading Rebels past No. 7 LSU with clutch game-winning TD drive per CBS Sports. Former D-II transfer takes over Heisman race. 325+ pass yds, 2+ pass TD, game-winning rush TD, sealing INT per StatMuse/ClutchPoints/ESPN.

story_log.title: Kentucky shocks No. 9 Texas A&M 31-21 on road — Will Stein's first marquee victory, Wildcats explode in third quarter
story_log.development: Kentucky upset No. 9 Texas A&M 31-21 in College Station per ground truth/CBS Sports. Third-quarter explosion delivered Stein's first signature win per CBS Sports. BarstoolReags: 'Feed the studs. Will Stein coached a perfect game. We were the better team.' Kentucky now face of SEC per BarstoolReags.

story_log.title: Northwestern demolishes Colorado 41-7 after Buffs player called stadium 'a f*cking library'
story_log.development: Northwestern destroyed Colorado 41-7 per ground truth. Colorado player called Ryan Field 'a f*cking library' before game per JomboyMedia. 'This place fucking sucks. Shit sounds like a fucking library. Colorado proceeded to lose 41-7 at Northwestern' per JomboyMedia. Got what they asked for.

story_log.title: Diamondbacks celebrate 25th anniversary of 2001 World Series — Randy Johnson and Curt Schilling hoist trophy, scoreboards altered to look like 2001
story_log.development: Dbacks celebrated 25th anniversary of 2001 WS team before Yankees game per TalkinBaseball/SportsCenter. Randy Johnson and Schilling hoisted trophy together per TalkinBaseball. Scoreboards altered to look like 2001 per TalkinBaseball. Pavin Smith walkoff HR completed night per TalkinBaseball. Arizona won 5-3 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Ronald Acuña Jr. crushes grand slam to put Braves on top in Houston — Astros fall out of playoff spot
story_log.development: Acuña hit grand slam to put Braves up in Houston per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. If everything holds Astros will not be in playoff spot at end of night per TalkinBaseball. Atlanta won 6-3 per ground truth. Houston slipping in AL West race.

story_log.title: Cal Raleigh launches 472-foot home run — longest of his career — to extend Mariners lead over Rockies
story_log.development: Raleigh hit 472-foot HR vs Colorado per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints — longest of his career per TalkinBaseball. Mariners beat Rockies 5-3 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Angel Reese becomes first WNBA player to record 500+ rebounds in single season — 30 double-doubles breaks league record
story_log.development: Reese vs Chicago: 23 PTS, 10 REB, 4 AST, 3 BLK, 2 STL per ClutchPoints — became first player in WNBA history to record 500+ rebounds in single season per ClutchPoints. Now has 30 double-doubles (WNBA record) and 505 rebounds (WNBA record) per ClutchPoints. Made history vs former team at 24 years old.

story_log.title: Golden State Valkyries beat Seattle Storm 70-57 — defensive stocks bonanza with 18 steals and 8 blocks
story_log.development: Valkyries beat Storm 70-57 per ground truth. Defensive stocks: Amihere 1 STL/2 BLK, Burton 1/1, Charles 4 STL, Chen 1 STL, Jocyte 1 STL, Stokes 4 BLK, Thornton 4 STL per StatMuse. 'Valkatraz' per StatMuse. Dominant defense.

story_log.title: NFL changes video board rules for field goals after viral Patriots gamesmanship — teams must use same All-22 angle for both kicking teams
story_log.development: NFL modified video board rules for FG/XP attempts after viral social-media post per Schefter/Pelissero — teams must now use same All-22 angle or static image for both kicking teams per Schefter. Modification designed to ensure competitive equity, violations will result in discipline per Schefter. Came after Patriots viral gamesmanship.

story_log.title: Yankees place Aaron Judge back on IL with calf strain — seven games after return from three-month absence

Friday night thriller.

story_log.title: Keyonte George and Jazz agree to 5-year, $157.5M extension after breakout 23.6 PPG season

story_log.title: Dodgers hit two pairs of back-to-back homers in same inning vs Giants — Betts two-homer game
story_log.development: Dodgers demolished Giants 8-2 per ground truth. Betts two-homer game per TalkinBaseball. story_log.development: Clark vs Tempo: 28 PTS, 14 AST, 6 REB per StatMuse/ClutchPoints — now tied with Olivia Miles for most points by rookie all-time at 769 per StatMuse. Mitchell broke single-season scoring record same game. Fever won 103-85 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Breanna Stewart passes Sue Bird on all-time scoring list in Liberty's win over Lynx
story_log.development: Stewart vs Minnesota: 24 PTS, 10 REB, 3 STL, +13 per StatMuse — passed Sue Bird on all-time scoring list per StatMuse. Liberty won 93-81 per ground truth. Milestone night for Stewart.

story_log.development: Pirates eliminated, will miss playoffs for 11th straight season per TalkinBaseball. Marlins also eliminated per TalkinBaseball. Cardinals eliminated too (fourth straight year missing postseason) per TalkinBaseball. Playoff races tighten.

story_log.development: Kiffin hired fraternity members to heckle his own LSU players at practice to prepare them for hostile Ole Miss environment per HaterReport. Top-10 matchup Saturday. story_log.development: Oregon destroyed Portland State 84-0 per ground truth/RedditCFB — most points since 97-0 win over Willamette in 1916 per RedditCFB. story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Allen has more rushing TDs than AFC West, NFC East, NFC West combined per StatMuse — also more passing TDs than AFC North per StatMuse. story_log.title: Bills demolish Lions 41-31 on Thursday Night Football — Josh Allen 5 total TDs in new Highmark Stadium opener, Detroit defense collapses
story_log.development: Bills destroyed Lions 41-31 per ground truth. Allen: 20-31, 248 pass yds, 69 rush yds, 5 total TD (3 pass, 2 rush) per StatMuse/ClutchPoints — first player in NFL history with 5+ pass TD and 4+ rush TD in first two games of a season per ClutchPoints, now leads NFL in both categories. story_log.title: Pittsburgh defeats Syracuse 27-13 to improve to 3-0, tied for best FBS record with USC and NDSU
story_log.development: Pitt beat Syracuse 27-13 per ground truth. Panthers now 3-0, tied for best record in FBS with USC and NDSU per RedditCFB. story_log.development: Young was carted off field after colliding with teammate McLean during play at first base per CBS Sports/SportsCenter/JomboyMedia. story_log.title: Dodgers clinch NL West for 13th time in last 14 years after beating Reds 8-2
story_log.development: Dodgers beat Reds 8-2 per ground truth, clinched NL West for 13th time in last 14 years per ESPN. Familiar feeling, kings of NL West per ESPN. Shohei Ohtani being placed on IL per TalkinBaseball (from Sept 10 content), Josue De Paula being called up per TalkinBaseball.

story_log.title: White Sox honor Tim Anderson with retirement ceremony before game vs Tigers, wear Southside City Connect uniforms for first time since 2024

story_log.development: Story hit 3-run HR in 8th to give Boston lead per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Red Sox won 4-3 per ground truth. Story clutch late.

story_log.title: Yordan Alvarez hits 40th home run of season — first 40-homer campaign of his career, AL MVP front-runner
story_log.development: Alvarez hit 40th HR of season per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints — first 40-homer season of his career per TalkinBaseball. AL MVP front-runner per TalkinBaseball. Astros beat Royals 6-2 per ground truth.

story_log.development: Bey agreed 3yr/$55.5M extension plus trade kicker per Shams. Missed entire 2024-25 season after torn ACL in Atlanta, then had resurgent comeback season last year in New Orleans averaging career-high 17.7 PPG per Shams. Fully guaranteed through 2029-30 per Shams.

story_log.title: Jackie Young drops 35 points on 12-18 FG vs Storm — ties WNBA record with 22 points in first quarter
story_log.development: Young vs Seattle: 35 PTS, 5 AST, 12-18 FG, +24 per StatMuse. Tied WNBA record for points scored in a quarter with 22 in 1Q per ClutchPoints/StatMuse. Only A'ja Wilson and Becky Hammon have more 30-PT games in franchise history per StatMuse. Aces beat Storm 114-77 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Angel Reese posts 30 points, 10 rebounds on 11-14 FG in Dream's 103-59 win over Sun — ties franchise record for most 30/10 games in single season
story_log.development: Reese vs Connecticut: 30 PTS, 10 REB, 2 BLK, 11-14 FG, +31 per StatMuse. Ties franchise record for most 30/10 games in single season per StatMuse. Dream demolished Sun 103-59 per ground truth. Dominant performance.

story_log.title: Pete Alonso hits 300th career home run at Citi Field against his former team the Mets, receives curtain call from Mets fans
story_log.development: Alonso hit 300th career HR with 2-run shot in 9th inning at Citi Field to tie game 5-5, then received curtain call from Mets fans per ground truth/TalkinBaseball/JomboyMedia/ClutchPoints. Orioles won 7-5 in extras per ground truth. First time Alonso reached 300 HR milestone. Mets fans chanted 'fire Stearns' after Alonso's curtain call per JomboyMedia. story_log.title: Junior Caminero hits second walk-off homer in five days, now leads AL with 41 homers and mounts late MVP run
story_log.development: Caminero hit walk-off HR to beat Athletics 3-1 per ground truth/TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints—his second walk-off HR in five days (also had one Sept. 12 to clinch playoff berth per recent history). He leads the AL with 41 homers and has done his best to mount a late run at stealing the AL MVP award away from the favored Yordan Alvarez.'

story_log.title: Guardians walk off White Sox to pull within half game of AL Central lead—Travis Bazzana's double after two HR from him earlier
story_log.development: Guardians walked off White Sox per ESPN/TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints—Cleveland now half game back of Chicago in AL Central per ESPN/TalkinBaseball. story_log.title: Brewers clinch NL Central for fourth straight season—first four-peat in NL Central history
story_log.development: Brewers beat Pirates 5-1 per ground truth, clinched NL Central for fourth straight year per ClutchPoints/TalkinBaseball—first ever four-peat in NL Central history per ClutchPoints. Milwaukee celebrating after locking up division.

story_log.development: Bedard named 37th captain of Blackhawks per ESPN/SportsCenter. Youngest captain in franchise history at 20 years old. NHL season returns Sept. 29 with ESPN triple-header starting at 5 PM ET per ESPN.

story_log.development: Gauthier and Anaheim agreed to 6yr contract with $13.5M AAV per ESPN/emilymkaplan. Major extension for young Ducks star. NHL returning in two weeks.

story_log.development: Mayo hit 3-run inside-the-park HR in 11th inning after Ewing crashed into wall per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Orioles beat Mets 7-5 in extras per ground truth. Wild finish after Alonso's 300th HR tied it.

story_log.title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto dominates Reds: 7.0 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 7 SO—sixth straight start with 7+ strikeouts
story_log.development: Yamamoto vs Reds: 7.0 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 2 BB, 7 SO per StatMuse—his sixth straight start with 7+ SO per StatMuse. Dodgers beat Reds 4-0 per ground truth. Dominant stretch continues.

story_log.development: Konchar agreed to 1yr deal with New York per Shams/ESPN. Entering eighth NBA season. Knicks add veteran depth.

story_log.development: Schefter reported Bears scored 59 in opener, Johnson pursuing 2013 Broncos' NFL single-season record of 606 points (37.9 PPG) per Schefter. Bears on historic scoring pace after Week 1 demolition of Panthers.

story_log.title: Yankees clinch playoff berth with 8-3 win over Twins — Aaron Judge first HR since return
story_log.development: Yankees clinched playoff berth (9th time in 10 years) per TalkinBaseball/ground truth. Judge hit first HR since rejoining Yankees (returning from May 31 injury) per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Ben Rice go-ahead HR in 8th gave Yankees lead per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Yankees beat Twins 8-3 per ground truth.

story_log.development: Dodgers clinched playoff berth (14th straight season) after beating Reds 4-1 per ground truth/TalkinBaseball/CBS Sports. Tarik Skubal dominant: 7.0 IP, 3 H, 0 R, 1 BB, 9 SO, 1.80 ERA this month per StatMuse. Dodgers now 14 straight years in postseason.

story_log.development: Mets eliminated from playoff contention after losing 2-1 to Orioles per TalkinBaseball/ground truth. Pete Alonso nearly hit 300th career HR (foul by inches) per TalkinBaseball. story_log.development: Brees seriously considered joining Denver for AFC Championship game after Bo Nix injury per Schefter/ESPN/PatMcAfeeShow. story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits 42nd HR of season, extends 40-30 club dominance
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 9]: PCA hit 42nd HR vs Atlanta per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints (4-5, 1 HR, 1 2B, 4 RBI per StatMuse). Now 42 HR, 37 SB this season. Cubs beat Braves 7-3 per ground truth. MVP race continues.

story_log.development: Detroit beat Toronto 6-5 per ground truth — Varland dropped ball at first base allowing go-ahead run per TalkinBaseball. story_log.title: Corbin Carroll walk-off 2-run HR gives Diamondbacks dramatic win over Marlins
story_log.development: Carroll hit walk-off 2-run HR for Arizona per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Diamondbacks beat Marlins 8-7 per ground truth. Lars Nootbaar tied game earlier per ClutchPoints. Wild finish.

story_log.development: White Sox allowed 3+ unearned runs and 0 earned runs in consecutive games per JayCuda — last team to do this was 1942 Yankees per JayCuda. White Sox beat Guardians 7-3 per ground truth. Defensive disaster, pitching okay.

story_log.development: Peters saw 18 pitches in walk per JomboyMedia — most by White Sox batter since MLB started tracking pitch counts in 1988 per JomboyMedia. story_log.development: Manning shared story about AI-edited video of Sark slapping Holly Rowe to ground per RedditCFB/HaterReport/NFLMemes — said he 'got a good laugh' and 'that's a good one' per HaterReport. Media training needed ASAP per HaterReport. Immediately regrettable quote.

story_log.title: Taj Gibson retires after 17 NBA seasons, returns to Chicago Bulls as assistant coach under Tiago Splitter
story_log.development: Gibson retired after 17 NBA seasons, returning to Bulls as assistant coach under Splitter per Shams. Career comes full circle.

story_log.title: Alexander Zverev defeats Ben Shelton in US Open final to win second Grand Slam of 2026

story_log.title: Giants defeat Cowboys 28-20 on Sunday Night Football in John Harbaugh's debut — Jaxson Dart, Cam Skattebo, Isaiah Likely shine
story_log.development: Giants beat Cowboys 28-20 on SNF per ground truth/SportsCenter/ClutchPoints. Dart: 23-29, 230 pass yds, 3 TD, 57 rush yds per ClutchPoints/StatMuse. story_log.development: Vikings beat Packers 39-22 per ground truth/ESPN. Ed Oliver got game ball per Schefter. Allen ended road woes vs Texans per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Ravens demolish Colts 41-23 in dominant Week 1 showing — Lamar Jackson MVP campaign starts hot
story_log.development: Ravens destroyed Colts 41-23 per ground truth. Lamar doing Lamar things per SharpFootball. PatMcAfeeShow: 'The Baltimore Ravens might be the greatest team in the history of the NFL.. we don't know right now.' Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist, will miss several weeks per ESPN/Schefter — ruled out in game. Ravens rolled to A- per CBS Sports Week 1 grades. Baltimore offense clicking.

story_log.title: Browns name Deshaun Watson starting QB over Shedeur Sanders after Watson went 5-of-12, 36 yards, 1 INT vs Bills backups—then Watson apologizes for calling fans disrespectful
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Cleveland officially named Watson QB1 per ESPN/Schefter/AdamSchefter. Watson apologized for postgame comments Saturday calling fans 'disrespectful' for booing him per ESPN/AdamSchefter. First two games on road (Jacksonville, Tampa), first home game Week 3 per AlbertBreer.

story_log.title: Browns waive ex-NFL TE Dae'Quan Wright, who has agreement to play for LSU if he clears waivers—first player to go from NFL roster back to college
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Cleveland officially waived Wright per Schefter/AdamSchefter/PatMcAfeeShow. He has agreement in place with LSU for 2026 season if he goes unclaimed on waivers per Schefter. First player to go from NFL roster back to college per Schefter.

story_log.title: Steelers at 'impasse' with Joey Porter Jr. as emerging cornerback holds in, Cowboys among possible landing spots
story_log.development: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Steelers at 'impasse' with Porter Jr. per CBS Sports/Schefter/AdamSchefter. Porter has been holding in as he hopes to land new contract per CBS Sports. Cowboys among possible landing spots per CBS Sports headline.

story_log.title: Angel Reese breaks WNBA single-game rebounding record with 26 boards, then breaks single-season rebounding record with 458 in same night
story_log.development: Reese vs LA Sparks: 26 REB (8 OREB), 11 PTS, 3 STL per StatMuse/ESPN/ClutchPoints. Broke WNBA record for most rebounds in single game per StatMuse/ESPN. Then broke single-season rebounding record with 458 per StatMuse—previous record was A'ja Wilson's 451 in 2024. Dream won, Allisha Gray had 20-5 per StatMuse.

story_log.title: Cal Raleigh hits three home runs in single game vs Phillies after not having a multi-homer game all season
story_log.development: Raleigh hit three HRs tonight vs Philadelphia per JomboyMedia/ClutchPoints/TalkinBaseball. Entering tonight hadn't had a multi-homer game all year per JomboyMedia. Julio Rodriguez also hit 3-run bomb off Zack Wheeler to give Seattle 5 runs in 1st inning per ClutchPoints/TalkinBaseball.

story_log.title: Patriots trade WR Kayshon Boutte to Texans for Jaylen Reed and draft pick, New England gets fleeced while filling key roster need
story_log.development: New England traded Boutte to Houston for S Jaylen Reed and 2028 seventh-round pick per TomPelissero/AdamSchefter/AlbertBreer/PatMcAfeeShow. CBS Sports: Texans fleece Patriots while filling key roster need per headline. Boutte should have better opportunity in contract year per AlbertBreer. Patriots need safety depth per AlbertBreer.

story_log.title: Dana Brown out as Astros GM, owner Jim Crane names himself temporary head of baseball operations
story_log.development: Brown out as Houston GM, Crane named himself temporary head of baseball operations per CBS Sports headline. Astros currently sit tied for first place in AL West at one game under .500 per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Shaedon Sharpe suffers torn meniscus, expected to miss six months in major blow to Trail Blazers
story_log.development: Sharpe sustained torn meniscus in knee, expected to miss six months per Shams/StatMuse. Last season: 20.8 PPG (career-high), 1.4 SPG, 2.1 3PM—top five in PPG by player under 30 MPG per StatMuse. Major loss for Portland.

story_log.title: Enes Kanter Freedom ejected from courtside seat at WNBA game after altercation with Natasha Cloud
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Internet still reacting to Kanter Freedom ejection—NBAMemes: 'on generational run', 'known more for WNBA antiques than NBA career', 'officially number 1 prospect for 2027 WNBA draft'. BallsackSports/W_B_Rick/ghetto_gronk shared clips. Story resolved but memes persist.

story_log.title: Ole Miss had FBI sweep for bugs after Lane Kiffin's departure to LSU, Rebels' NIL director claims
story_log.development: Paranoia at all-time high in Oxford after Kiffin left for LSU per CBS Sports. Ole Miss NIL director claims school had FBI sweep for bugs per CBS Sports headline. RedditCFB: 'Imagine being FBI agent dispatched to Oxford to investigate college football beef on Uncle Sam's dime lmao.'

story_log.title: LSU's RJ Luis receives preliminary injunction for immediate eligibility after signing two-day deal with Utah Jazz but never playing in G-League
story_log.development: Luis received preliminary injunction for immediate eligibility during 2026-27 season per JonRothstein. Signed two-day deal with Jazz but never played G-League game due to injury per JonRothstein. Was Big East POY at St. John's in 2024-25 per JonRothstein. Will Wade wins another legal battle.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber hits walk-off home run to cap Phillies' winning week, Aaron Nola and Andrew Painter getting right
story_log.development: Schwarber hit walk-off bomb per PatMcAfeeShow/CespedesBBQ. Phillies W9 punctuated by humongous Schwarber walk-off HR per CespedesBBQ pod. Nola/Painter getting right per CespedesBBQ. Philadelphia won 9 straight.

story_log.title: Late balk call allows run to score after it seemed like inning was over
story_log.development: Late balk call allowed run to score after it seemed inning was over per JomboyMedia. Controversial umpire decision.

story_log.title: Tennessee names true freshman Faizon Brandon starting QB, first true freshman to start season opener since 2004
story_log.development: Tennessee named Brandon starting QB per ESPN/PatMcAfeeShow. He'll be first true freshman QB to start for Vols in season opener since 2004 per ESPN.

story_log.title: Alabama names Keelon Russell starting quarterback over Ty Simpson
story_log.development: Keelon Russell named starting QB for Alabama per PatMcAfeeShow. Big QB decision for Crimson Tide.

story_log.title: Allen Robinson retires: silky smooth route-runner went 80-1400-14 at 22 with Blake Bortles, then had great stretch with Bears
story_log.development: Robinson retired per Ihartitz. Went 80-1400-14 at 22 years old with Bortles in 2015 per Ihartitz. Messed up knee but picked himself up, had great stretch with Bears per Ihartitz. Ihartitz: 'They'll sing songs one day about his training camp with the Rams.' Career over.

story_log.title: Cardinals waive/injured RB Trey Benson—talented, promising player who just hasn't been able to stay on field
story_log.development: Arizona waived/injured Benson per AdamSchefter/FieldYates. FieldYates: 'Tough for Trey Benson. A talented and promising player who just hasn't been able to stay on the field enough to carve out a role.' Injuries derail young RB.

story_log.title: Giants WR Malik Nabers sheds red no-contact jersey, takes part in live drills for first time with Week 1 in sight
story_log.development: Nabers shed red no-contact jersey, took part in live drills for first time Monday with Week 1 in sight per AdamSchefter/ESPN. Harbaugh: 'reasonable to assume' Nabers ready for opener per AdamSchefter headline.

story_log.title: Alabama walks off Pennsylvania in Little League World Series after trailing 5-0 in 3rd inning
story_log.development: Alabama trailed 5-0 in 3rd inning, came back to win per ESPN. Walk-off win for Alabama per ESPN headline. LLWS delivering drama.
